# RCO Roadmap Note: Assembly Optimizations
# -----------------------------------------
# This directory is reserved for manual Assembly (.s / .asm) optimizations
# that cannot be generated by the Rust compiler.
# 
# Current Status:
# - Most SIMD (AVX-512/NEON) logic is handled via Rust intrinsics (core::arch).
# - Future Stage-IV (Recursive Hardware Inversion) may require manual 
#   entry points for TEE/SGX enclaves here.
